facts.value: Online Bachelor of Science in Technical Communication

ASU’s online Bachelor of Science in technical communication prepares you to translate complex information into content that helps people make decisions and take action. This program builds the writing, design and research skills that open doors across high-growth industries. Technical communicators and technical writers work in software, healthcare, government and nonprofits, creating a clear, user-friendly experience that reduces friction and increases functionality.
technical writing, design and research skills, understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, web authoring and digital content strategy.
By the time you complete the program, you’ll have a robust professional portfolio that proves your immediate value across the tech ecosystem.
